description: Removes the passcode or invite-only setting from a whole site (path "/", the default) or the protection from one path (owner; an AI gets approve_url for the owner). A protected path stays protected until opened by its own path.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: approval status

path.description: "/" (default, whole site) or a protected part such as /students

name: unprotect
title: Remove protection
